ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Abans Enterprises Limited is notifying shareholders holding physical shares to update their PAN, KYC, and nomination details in compliance with a mandatory SEBI Master Circular. Failure to comply will materially impact shareholders by restricting services and blocking all payments, including dividends, until their records are complete and payments can be processed electronically. This is a routine regulatory compliance action and does not present financial red flags for the company.
